A '''drowned''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] is a vanilla underwater zombie with new drops: {{ItemLink|Tattered Leather}} instead of rotten flesh and a chance of {{ItemLink|Raw Estus}}, with no copper. Once the [[Ender Dragon]] has been killed, drowned can only appear deep underwater, below sea level and out of sight of the sky.

== Spawning ==
Drowned use the vanilla spawn rules. As undead, they aren't removed from the open surface before the dragon is killed.

After the dragon is killed, a drowned is removed as soon as it appears if it can see the sky or is at Y=63 or above. Unlike other mobs, this applies inside trial chambers and abbeys too.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/predicate/drowned_surface_spawn.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/safe_surface.mcfunction}}</ref> See [[Surface]].

== Drops ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/drowned}}
All drops require a player kill.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/drowned.json}}</ref> Compared to vanilla, {{ItemLink|Tattered Leather}} (1–2) replaces rotten flesh (0–2), and a 50% chance of {{ItemLink|Raw Estus}} (0–1, so about 1 in 4 drowned drops one without Looting) replaces the chance of a {{ItemLink|Copper Ingot}}. The pack means to stop drowned dropping the tridents and other equipment they spawn with, but a bug stops this from working reliably; see [[Spawning#Mob modifications]].

== Behavior ==
Drowned are undead, so [[warding]] hurts them.

== Difficulty ==
Adult drowned keep their vanilla attributes on every difficulty. Baby drowned get new health values:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/normal_and_easy_modifications/modify_baby_zombies.mcfunction}}</ref>
{{Data/Difficulty/Drowned}}

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Drowned need to be below Y=43 to spawn after the dragon is killed. Baby drowned have 2 hearts on Easy. Obols no longer drop from undead.}}
}}
The 1.12.1-alpha release notes give Y=43 for the drowned limit, but the code uses Y=63.
